To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the similarity between classical and Bayesian estimates for mixed logit models is confirmed for six datasets and for both cross‐sectional and panel data; (2) the Bayesian estimates are more accurate in the sense that they are closer to the true values of the coefficients; (3) the Bayesian estimates have a higher precision than the classical estimates; (4) the classical estimates have a higher bias than the Bayesian estimates.
